chunks: Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr narrated from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who performs hajj on behalf of his father: should he perform tamattuʿ?
He said: “Yes, the tamattuʿ is for him, and the hajj is on behalf of his father.”
ai.seo_question: Can someone performing hajj on behalf of his father do hajj al-tamattuʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about deputized hajj on behalf of one's father. It states that the person performing the pilgrimage may do hajj al-tamattuʿ for himself in form, while the hajj itself counts on behalf of his father.
